runtime.socketScaleNote: Original Ash Witness sockets inherit 0.01 scale. Attach code must compensate to preserve the authored metre sizes.

sourcing.geometry: Original closed semantic meshes authored offline; no new generation job, no copied organ model.
sourcing.albedo: Existing generated tissue swatches reused with locally authored bone/ash-skin/fascia identity regions. Not scanned/calibrated PBR.
sourcing.normalAndRoughness: Locally authored coupled pore/fibre fields; physical identity roughness and restrained micro-normal variation.

limits: Cinematic fictional anatomical inspiration, not medical reconstruction or AAA realism.
Generated tissue albedo contains baked lighting cues; roughness and micro-normal maps are authored approximations.
Bowel loops are static geometry. Local overlap/contact is authored; no collision or volume-preserving softbody simulation.
Mesentery is finished thin opaque geometry; translucency and real tissue scattering are not represented.
Separate wound inserts require character mask/cull integration; they do not cut the preserved character by themselves.
PC runtime contact, socket placement and lighting reviewed within the recorded bounded poses; all-pose anatomical realism remains unverified.
Bone fracture, fascia and bowel folds remain visibly procedural/stylized at extreme close range.
Individually closed tissue components meet by authored overlap; this is not a boolean-unioned medical topology.
Direct macro back views still reveal stretched radial-fan UVs and faceted backing geometry; the dark tissue identity correction does not certify a sculpted underside.
qualityVerdict: Offline topology/maps and neutral front/back views passed; final 17 PC runtime views and independent review accept bounded action readability with art limitations. Professional anatomical realism is not established.

visualReview.lighting: Neutral key/fill/rim at authored metre dimensions, no bloom
corrections: Preserved generated roughness/normal pixels by assigning non-color space before pixel upload.
Finished the narrow mesentery root strip and all bone-arch UVs without collapsed triangles.
Added dark marrow recessed inside irregular bone cortex and stained arch sectors.
Recolored and refined mesentery pleats to reduce the canvas-sheet appearance.
Mapped all closed wound undersides to dark cavity tissue, retaining gray ash skin only on the narrow exterior border.
remainingLimits: Very tight bowel bends reveal some angular longitudinal segments in a full-frame closeup.
Opaque membrane has no real translucency or tissue scattering.
Skin border coloration is generic ash gray and needs the runtime character lighting to confirm its match.
Runtime uses the measured posed seam centroid/span, cached in the original socket frame; the nonplanar boundary is not rebuilt every animation frame.
Direct macro back views still reveal stretched radial-fan UVs and faceted backing geometry; the dark tissue identity correction does not certify a sculpted underside.

sourceFitMeasurement.method: Rest-position exterior vertex slice within 0.006 m of y=1.58 m; includes the full original scanned surface
sourceFitMeasurement.fitDecision: Keep the .164 m authored neck width; moving the runtime frame roughly .062 m posterior is safer than shrinking the cap without matching the cut. Arm dimensions unchanged pending a precise shoulder plane measurement.
sourceFitMeasurement.runtimeImplementation: Use posed .5 one-hot skin boundary segment centroid and planar span, socket.worldToLocal storage and socket.localToWorld tracking; no fixed posterior guess or source-socket mutation.

Closed surfaces, consistent winding, no degenerate triangles
All UV triangles have positive area; finite unit normals
Albedo, packed metal/roughness and normal maps retained in GLB
All image dependencies embedded in GLB
Three front and two back neutral closeups rendered and inspected
notCertified: Professional anatomical realism, all deforming poses and all targets

limitations: Source neck/fabric boundaries and survivor sleeves remain angular at macro range.
Fused/open fingers do not have independent closing contact.
Organ bundle is static authored geometry rather than deformable softbody tissue.
Measured cap fit is cached once per wound; no continuously rebuilt fracture topology.
Fragments settle cosmetically; complete prop collision and skeletal instancing are not added.
Full-body bisection and head crushing are not part of the three implemented counters.
